That night, he polished the great lens longer than usual, and when the beam swept across the black water, he imagined it reaching some distant shore, answering a stranger's quiet hello.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在薄雾里投下昏黄的光，空荡的街道像一条沉睡的河。环卫工人挥动扫帚，沙沙声在楼宇间回荡。远处的早餐铺亮起灯，蒸笼里升起第一缕白气。偶尔有出租车驶过，尾灯划出一道红色的影子。写字楼大多漆黑，只有几扇窗还亮着，像未眠的眼睛。天边泛起淡淡的鱼肚白，新的一天正悄悄醒来，而整座城市仍在梦与现实之间徘徊。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a problem is solved by using a smaller copy of the same problem, like a set of nesting dolls.\n- Each time you open a doll, you do the same thing again until you reach the tiniest doll that can't be opened, which is the stopping point.\n- Then you put everything back together, one doll at a time, and the whole problem is solved."}
